description:
Calcula, para un límite de N solicitudes por ventana, el espaciado mínimo, la duración total mínima y la espera del próximo llamado. Cuándo: un flujo de agente necesita un resultado exacto y repetible para un paso auxiliar (tokens, costos, reintentos, fragmentos, ranking, limpieza de JSON). No para: calcular los tiempos de espera entre reintentos (backoff-schedule). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Computes, for a limit of N requests per window and a number of calls to make, the minimum spacing between calls, the minimum total duration and a token-bucket wait time for the next call. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Computes, for a limit of N requests per window and a number of calls to make, the minimum spacing between calls, the minimum total duration and a token-bucket wait time for the next call. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: computing retry delays for exponential, linear or constant backoff with a cap and optional jitter (backoff-schedule). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

burst.description: Bucket capacity (default = limit) (integer; optional; min 1; max 1000000000).

calls.description: Calls you need to make (integer; optional; default 0; min 0; max 1000000000).

limit.description: Requests allowed per window (integer; required; min 1; max 1000000000).

tokens_available.description: Tokens currently in bucket (number; optional; min 0).

window_seconds.description: Window length in seconds (number; required; > 0; max 31536000).
